name: Google Calendar
description: Google Calendar is Google's calendar and scheduling service for calendars, events, guests, and availability.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact primary Google account and default calendar through Relay's verified confidential Google OAuth client with exactly three Calendar scopes, then let agents list bounded calendars/events, query FreeBusy, and create or ETag-update reviewed events. Relay blocks deletion, admin/sharing, notifications, attachments, Meet creation, private properties, bulk export, and raw APIs.

capabilities.label: Read calendars and events
capabilities.description: List bounded calendars and event details in explicit time ranges.

capabilities.label: Read availability
capabilities.description: Query bounded free/busy intervals for explicit calendars.

capabilities.label: Create and update events
capabilities.description: Create or update exact reviewed events without guest notifications.

allowed.label: List calendars
allowed.description: List the first bounded page of safe calendar identity metadata.

allowed.label: List events
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five events in an explicit calendar and time range.

allowed.label: Query availability
allowed.description: Return bounded busy intervals for at most ten explicit calendars.

approvalRequired.label: Create event
approvalRequired.description: Create one exact reviewed event without sending guest notifications.

approvalRequired.label: Update event
approvalRequired.description: Patch one exact reviewed event using an ETag without sending guest notifications.

blocked.label: Delete or move events
blocked.description: Delete, move, import, quick-add, watch, batch mutation, and sync traversal are blocked.

blocked.label: Administer calendars
blocked.description: Calendar, CalendarList, ACL, settings, sharing, notification, and ownership mutations are blocked.

blocked.label: Add risky event content
blocked.description: Attachments, Meet/conference creation, private or extended properties, guest notification side effects, and arbitrary recurrence expansion are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw Calendar APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, raw Google/MCP tools, automatic pagination, broad export, credentials, and broader scopes are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded calendar, event, and availability reads are direct; event creates and updates require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All five selected wrappers run without per-action approval while exact scopes/account/calendar bounds, audit, and provider controls remain enforced.
